summary: Soto's record shows consistent pro-Israel positioning: he endorsed Jerusalem's recognition as Israel's capital in 2017, voted Yea on H.R. 6090 adopting the IHRA definition in Title VI education enforcement, and activists in 2024 cited his record of voting for increased Israel funding, censuring Rep. Tlaib, and not recognizing Gaza Health Ministry death counts. His October 2025 statement condemns Hamas and calls for aid to Palestinians, but frames the conflict around hostage return and Israeli-Gaza negotiations rather than Israeli military conduct.
